items.source_en:
Blood work results:
Albumin levels at 5.2 g/dl, out of healthy range. May be indicator of liver or kidney problems. Blood Urea Nitrogen in the high range (19 mg/dl) but otherwise normal. Potassium levels low due to possible diuretic intake.

Additional notes:
Patient complained recent vomiting, abdominal pain, and blood in stool, consistent with arsenic poisoning. Patient was advised to take further lab tests but refused.
